chapters.title: Chapter 5: Strict Compliance Doctrine in Louisiana Insurance Cancellations (Delatte, Eaglin, Britten, Hodges)
chapters.reason: This chapter explicitly presents and teaches the case-law doctrinal rules (strict compliance, effect of defects, timing/cure mechanics, and 'receipt' triggers). Including excerpts from Delatte, Eaglin, Britten, and Hodges is essential so students/readers can see the courts' precise holdings and language that define the statute's operation and the limits of substantial-compliance arguments.

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Certification of State-Law Questions to State Supreme Courts (with Jefferson v. Lead Industries Assan)
chapters.reason: Chapter 11 treats certification standards and strategy and explicitly cites Jefferson v. Lead Industries Ass'n. An excerpt of Jefferson is needed so readers can review the Fifth Circuit's test and phrasing regarding when federal courts should (or should not) certify unsettled state-law questions.
